observed_failure: Page.wait_for_function: Timeout 60000ms exceeded at initial readiness wait.
cause: Regression intercepts requestAnimationFrame for a deterministic clock, but the new readiness wait accidentally used Playwright's default requestAnimationFrame polling. The preceding real-clock smoke passed.
correction: Use explicit polling=50 as in the prior proven checker.
separate_review_finding: Full low-tide capture ends mid-cycle at2880ms; retain all frames but stop at endpoint instead of looping.
